subject: Audit logs & evidence request — next steps and sample export
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fincobank.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit logs & evidence request — next steps and sample export

Hi Laura — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your security team the artefacts they asked for:

- What we heard: FinCo needs access/audit logs showing who accessed customer data, what operations were performed (read/export/delete), timestamps, and the ability to export these logs for internal audit. You also asked about retention defaults and options for longer storage or on-demand exports.
- What we'll provide: a redacted sample export of our access/audit logs (CSV + NDJSON), a short spec of event fields, and the procedures for requesting a complete export (S3 export or signed export delivery). We can also include our data handling policy and SOC 2 section references.
- Next steps:
  1) I'll attach a redacted sample log and our data handling policy in a follow-up email (see attachments).
  2) Ben (security) will confirm the exact event fields and retention/backup guarantees.
  3) If that looks good, can we schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security/ops folks next week to walk through the sample? Available windows: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

If you prefer a deep-dive with SRE and product on the call, loop them in and we’ll extend to 45 minutes.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment stubs: audit_log_sample.csv (CSV, 200KB), redwood_data_handling_policy.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinCo Bank Security <security@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs & evidence request — next steps and sample export

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifying questions before we book the follow-up:

1) For the sample export: can you confirm the exact event/schema fields you include? We need: user_id, user_role, action_type (read/write/export/delete), object_id, object_type, timestamp (UTC), source_ip, request_id, and whether the payload included PII.
2) Retention: what's the default retention window for access logs in Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private? Is there an option for archiving to our S3 for >365 days?
3) Evidence: for audits we often need signed attestations or chain-of-custody for exports. Can you describe the delivery mechanism and any tamper-evidence (e.g., signed manifests) you support?

If you can answer 1–3 in-line that will help our security team triage. I'll also drop available times for Tue/Wed morning PT below.

Laura
Lead Security Engineer | FinCo Bank
laura.chen@fincobank.com | (212) 555-0102

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fincobank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-20T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs & evidence request — next steps and sample export

Laura — thanks for the clear list. Short answers below and I attached a redacted CSV sample and the event-field spec.

1) Event/schema fields: we include all of the fields you listed. Specifically: event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_user_id, actor_email, actor_role, action (read/write/export/delete), resource_id, resource_type, request_id, source_ip, user_agent, bytes_returned, response_status, and a redaction_flag (true if payload contained PII and was redacted). The attached "audit_log_sample.csv" shows column headers and 100 redacted rows.

2) Retention: Hosted default is 90 days for raw access logs; Dedicated can be configured by contract (90–365 days); Private deployments: retention is customer-controlled. We support automated archival to a customer S3 bucket for any retention period — archived exports are delivered as gzipped NDJSON with a signed manifest.

3) Evidence/chain-of-custody: exports are generated as gzipped NDJSON or CSV, checksummed, and we provide a signed manifest (SHA256 + Redwood service signature). For Hosted exports we can deliver via a pre-signed S3 link or push to your S3 (per contract). For Dedicated/Private, we can coordinate a signed delivery and provide a time-stamped manifest file for audits.

Proposed next step: I can share the redacted sample now (attached) and we can do a 30-min follow-up to walk through fields and export flows. Marissa — can you book Tue 2026-04-28 10:30 PT?

Ben
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: audit_log_sample.csv (CSV, 200KB), event_field_spec.md (Markdown, 12KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-20T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs & evidence request — next steps and sample export

Great — attaching the redacted sample and our data handling policy (pdf). Ben, thanks for the clear answers; I copied the key points below for Laura's audit ticket.

- Schema: event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_user_id, actor_role, actor_email (redacted on request), action, resource_id, resource_type, request_id, source_ip, user_agent, bytes_returned, response_status, redaction_flag.
- Export formats: CSV (flat table) and NDJSON (gzipped for large exports).
- Retention: Hosted default = 90 days; Dedicated configurable up to 365; Private = customer-controlled. Archival to customer S3 supported.
- Evidence: gzipped exports + SHA256 manifest; manifests signed by Redwood service keys; delivery via pre-signed S3 link or push.

Laura — putting proposed meeting on the calendar for Tue 2026-04-28 10:30 PT. Please confirm and add any additional folks from your team.

—Marissa

Attachment stubs: audit_log_sample.csv (CSV, 200KB), redwood_data_handling_policy.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

Laura
